entries.title: Jeremiah 13:1
segments:
Put it not in water; a direction signifying that God's covenant people are unclean in their hearts and lives. 
 
vv 1-14. 
 
Those who put their trust in outward privileges, and neglect holiness of heart and life, God will disown and put to shame, both in this world and that which is to come.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:4
segments: Go to Euphrates--hide it there; a symbol of the humiliation of God's people by their removal to Babylon in a state of captivity.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:13
segments: I will fill all the inhabitants of this land--with drunkenness; strong drink, which causes bewilderment and reeling, is a frequent figure for God's judgments.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:16
segments: To nations, as well as individuals, God graciously gives a day of light and mercy, which they may improve for their salvation; but if they neglect this, and harden their hearts in sin, the sun of their day will set to rise no more.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:17
segments: God's faithful servants are deeply moved at the rejection of their messages, for they foresee the ruin that must follow.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:18
segments: As unfaithful rulers and teachers are first in leading God's people into sin, so shall they be first in suffering his judgments.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:20
segments: Them that come from the north; the invading armies of the enemy.
Where is the flock; the rulers of Jerusalem are rebuked for causing the Lord's flock to perish through their sins.  Compare

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:21
segments: Hast taught them; the heathen nations, by seeking their aid and alliance, and imitating their idolatries.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:23
segments: Nothing but divine grace is strong enough to break the fetters of sinful habit which has from the first held sway in the soul, and to set it free from "the law of sin" which is in the members.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:25
segments: The portion of thy measures; the portion of punishment measured out to thee by me.
